pkgmetadata.longdescription: The prebuilt form of app-editors/zeo at the same version: the same Zed commit, the same patch series and the default USE set, compiled for x86-64-v3 (Haswell / Zen 1 and newer). PROVENANCE.txt, installed with the documentation, names the commit, every patch with its sha256, the USE set and the compiler flags.
